reviews.q:
As a coffee company in Rotterdam, we couldn't ignore it anymore — matcha had to be added to our assortment. But which one? And what exactly is really good matcha? Through mutual connections, I got in touch with Robbert-Jan from Superfoods Partners. He fully immersed me in the world of matcha — we tasted several and experienced the different flavour profiles.

One clear winner came out of the tasting: Premium Matcha, South China. What really made the difference for us was that the matcha is traded fairly — they know the farmers and pay a fair price. So… it was a match(a)! After that, everything was arranged quickly. Thank you for your enthusiasm and all the valuable matcha knowledge.
reviews.name: Angela

reviews.q: We've tried multiple matcha suppliers over the years, but Superfoods Partners stands out. The quality is consistent, vibrant, and our customers noticed the difference immediately. Fast delivery, clear communication, and a team that truly understands the product.
reviews.name: Laticia

reviews.q: Amazing matcha! Perfect price-to-quality for horeca. Great communication with the account manager — love working together! 🍵
reviews.name: Mariel van Cece

reviews.q: I've been working with Superfoods Partners for the past few months, and the experience has been exceptional. Their communication is smooth, their operations are efficient, and they consistently deliver high-quality tea I can rely on. They've proven to be trustworthy partners, and I'm genuinely grateful for our collaboration. I have full confidence that this strong partnership will continue well into the future.
reviews.name: Joana

about.metaTitle: Company — the trusted superfood sourcing partner
about.metaDescription: Superfoods Partners is an international supplier of traceable superfood powders, operating from Hong Kong, Amsterdam and Los Angeles. Pure Matcha Partners is our specialist matcha brand.
about.heroBody1: Superfoods Partners is the umbrella for our group — one shared portfolio of traceable superfood powders, with local operating entities in Hong Kong, the Netherlands and the United States. We manage supply directly at the farms and move large, verified volumes to manufacturers, brands and private label. Your partner at every stage, from source to scale.
about.heroBody2: We don't aspire to be the largest supplier. We aspire to be the one you never have to worry about.

matcha-protein.flavour: Matcha brings its green colour and grassy, umami character; the protein softens it into a rounder, creamier profile. The ratio decides how much the matcha leads, and we tune it on samples with you.

earl-grey-matcha.flavour: Earl grey brings the citrus lift of bergamot and the depth of black tea; matcha adds green colour and umami. Depending on the ratio, the result reads as a bergamot-scented matcha or a softer, darker tea latte.
